answer: The voyage index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1608 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the delta. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the ember queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
